**verdict**: AMP M5 champion (phasehz11_s29) fine-tuned on 60s joystick sessions closes the slip gap on genuinely-translating episodes but the held-out joygate's headline slip/dir numbers were badly corrupted by an eval-harness bug found and fixed this cycle, not by the checkpoint itself. Evidence: raw joygate report (n=24, DR-0) shows falls=0/24 and 8/24 episodes with cmd_dist_m=0.0 (whole-episode hold/turn-in-place stress_mix draws) where slip_per_m's old formula (slip_m/max(along_dist,0.05)) exploded to 127-232 on ordinary marching-in-place foot travel (~9-11m/60s) purely from the 0.05m floor -- these 8 episodes dominated the reported n=24 median (176.8) even though every one of the 16 translating episodes was healthy. Recomputed on the SAME raw data with the fix applied (slip_per_m := None when cmd_dist_m<=0, matching the progress_ratio guard already one line above it in eval_checkpoint.py): translating-episode slip/m median = 3.12 (n=16, was reported 176.8) -- beats the PARTIAL bar (<=3.3) and improves on the parent's 3.679; direction_err median = 47.16deg (marginal vs parent 48.15, still above both the 40deg PASS and 45deg PARTIAL bars); gait_valid_frac 0.833 (4/12 sto episodes sacrifice a leg, a real regression the old metric never surfaced either). Net: real, if partial, progress on the ONE axis this fine-tune targeted (slip), no falls, but direction tracking is still broken and stochastic-mode leg-sacrifice is a new open question -- calling this PARTIAL, not PASS (dir_ok/gait_valid_all both still fail) and not FAIL (reward rose throughout AND the corrected slip reading is real improvement, so per the 08-21 ruling this is progress-with-open-gaps, not a dead recipe). SEPARATE FINDING (not yet gated): this recipe zeroed every walkcurr-lineage stop-shaping reward term (k_walk_stop_charge/current, walk_stop_freeze_s all absent from its cfg-set list) and visibly does not stand still on zero-speed hold commands -- it keeps a marching gait (raw slip_m_total ~9-11m/60s, same magnitude as when actually walking) with nothing pricing that. The DONE-gate math has no explicit 'stands still on stop' check today; if joystick-track hold/stop robustness becomes gate-relevant again, this checkpoint is a clean negative example and the walkcurr V7 stop-freeze mechanism (already proven on the walkcurr lineage) is the fix to import. No further training funded this cycle: joystick DONE gate is already independently met (stotight45 lineage, 08-23) and AMP is maintenance-only -- this was an operator-ordered exploratory fusion arm, now closed with lessons banked, not gate-blocking.
